capabilities: Sync the vault to a WebDAV server in upload-only, download-only, or bidirectional direction
Transfer incrementally (changes only) or force full alignment
Auto-sync after local changes and on an optional polling interval
Preview pending transfers and abort sync when deletions exceed a threshold
Diagnose connection issues and sync state with a generated report
extras: Password is stored encrypted in data.json, but the README warns the key ships in the plugin source, so this is obfuscation rather than strong encryption; it also documents server-specific pitfalls like Chinese directory names returning 404 on Synology.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service and doesn't connect to your own WebDAV server, leaving self-hosters without a direct device-to-NAS sync option.

requires.name: WebDAV server (fnOS, Synology DSM, Nextcloud, or generic WebDAV)

summary: Lightweight WebDAV sync plugin that mirrors a vault to a NAS or self-hosted server with upload-only, download-only, or bidirectional modes.
